headline: Wardens Gain Posts in Weathered Expanse and Stonecradle
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, Weathered Expanse has moved from a five-four Warden majority to six-three, and Stonecradle from six Colonial, two Warden, and one wasted post to six Colonial and three Warden, the ruined point now flying the Warden banner. Linn Mercy still shows ten Colonial posts against one dark no-man's-land post, but Lathair and Rotdust remain the busiest points and the region logged another ten ownership entries in two hours. Stlican Shelf holds at five Warden posts to four Colonial, its Thornhold duel quiet this cycle. Mooring County keeps all twelve posts for the Wardens, while Callahan's Passage has not changed hands though its casualty lists climb sharply. Dead Lands, without a base event in six hours, shows a sudden acceleration in casualties; Weathered Expanse likewise reports mounting hourly losses on both sides around Crow's Nest and Frostmarch. No victor has been declared.
